nodes.title: USAGE
widgets_values:
H3 SOURCE CLIP PREPARATION

Upload a long video in Load Video. Three minutes or longer is fine.

Exactly 124 frames / 24 fps = 5.1666667 seconds. The 5.17 label is rounded; cutting arithmetic is not.

ONE SECTION: mode=Selected chunk; set start_seconds; first_chunk=1.
ONE NUMBERED CHUNK: mode=Selected chunk; start_seconds=0; first_chunk=N.
ALL CHUNKS: mode=Consecutive chunks; start_seconds=0; first_chunk=1; chunk_count=0.
A RANGE: Consecutive chunks; choose first_chunk and chunk_count.

Short tail is skipped by default. Hold last frame is optional and explicitly marked in the manifest. No motion is invented.

Outputs: output/h3_clips/<unique run>/. Two or more clips also get a ZIP. Workbench > Files exposes MP4, ZIP and CSV.

Refresh ComfyUI after export. In the HMOTION Load Video dropdown choose an h3clip_ file; set source start_seconds=0 and leave window_seconds=5.25. No re-upload needed.

CPU-only FFmpeg; no H3, pose, or Ollama model loading in this workflow. Source is unchanged. H.264 CRF 16 by default, not lossless. SDR inputs only.

This creates source chunks. It does not automatically render a whole movie, maintain identity between generations, or stitch generated outputs.

Requires the rebuilt H3 image containing H3 Clip Preparation. The JSON alone does not install its new node.
